newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank denies plan to suspend 5 banks.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank denies plan to suspend 5 banks.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Friday denied rumours that it planned to suspend five medium and small Thai commercial banks from Monday.
The central bank said the rumours had been fabricated by unscrupulous individuals to cause disturbances in the financial system.
The bank stressed in a statement that it had no plan to suspend any commercial banks.
Brokers said the bank suspension talk contributed to a 3.20 percent loss of the composite SET Index on Friday.
All but one of 16 listed Thai banks closed lower with the bank sectorial index retreating 5.22 percent.
